dedupe_keys.name: green efficient frontier portfolio model with scenario analysis and stress testing for indian markets 2023

description: This model builds an environment-friendly portfolio for the Indian stock market by adding ESG ratings to modern portfolio theory, giving what the authors call a green efficient frontier, with the environmental score as a third dimension beside mean and variance. Scenario analyses and stress tests based on current action levels, policies and market information are then used to anticipate how the green portfolio would perform in different circumstances, and its performance is compared with market returns to argue that climate risk is a significant factor in financial analysis. It was developed by Shashwat Mishra, Rishabh Raj and Siddhartha P. Chakrabarty and posted on arXiv on 26 May 2023. Coverage is Indian equities. The preprint is available free online; only the arXiv licence link is shown and no code is linked. Caveats: ESG ratings differ between providers, the scenarios are the authors' own, and the preprint was not checked for later publication. For simulation it gives a simple way to represent investor preference for greener firms when modelling capital flows in climate transition scenarios for emerging markets. It is related to the decarbonised index-tracking portfolio optimisation model record in this catalogue.
